description: Search Blueprint principles by free-text query and return the closest matches ranked by relevance. Use this to find principles related to a specific design challenge, failure mode, or keyword (e.g. 'reversibility', 'approval flow', 'delegation boundary'). Returns principle title, cluster, definition, rationale, and implementation heuristics. Prefer this over principles.list when you have a specific topic in mind rather than wanting all principles. The lens picks the doctrine searched: 'architecture' = the 10 agentic principles (default), 'surface' = the 8 experience-design laws, 'spec' = the 8 spec-quality laws, 'all' = all 26 (each result then names its lens). Laws also match on their eponym (e.g. 'Hick', 'Fitts').

lens.description: Which public doctrine to search: 'architecture' = the 10 agentic principles (default), 'surface' = the 8 experience-design laws, 'spec' = the 8 spec-quality laws, 'all' = all three.
